cues: Then the essence of wisdom: emancipation, as far as possible, from the tyranny of the here and now.
Our senses are egoistic; sight and touch start from our own bodies, and our emotions start from ourselves.
A baby feels only its own hunger.
As we grow, the circle widens: family, nation, all humanity, all time.
Nobody can be completely impartial, but a continual approach towards impartiality is growth in wisdom: by knowing things remote in time and space, and by giving them their due weight in our feelings.
